investor.subject: Welcome to TrueCap. Start with one listing
investor.headline: Start with one real listing
body: Your free trial is on: 21 days, three complete Pro deals, one comparison. No card, and nothing renews.
The one thing to do first is paste a listing you are actually considering. A real deal shows you more in two minutes than a sample does.
You get cash flow, DSCR, and the Offer Ceiling: the highest price that still meets your targets. Every assumption is labeled and editable.

agent.subject: Welcome to TrueCap. Start with one listing
agent.preheader: Paste a listing a client is considering.
agent.headline: Start with one client listing
body: Your free trial is on: 21 days, three complete Pro deals, one comparison. No card, and nothing renews.
The one thing to do first is paste a listing one of your investor clients is considering. A real deal shows you more in two minutes than a sample does.
You get cash flow, DSCR, and the Offer Ceiling: the highest price that still meets that client's targets. Every assumption is labeled and editable.
